{{recipe}}

'''Cheese on toast''' is a simple concept but easy to get wrong.

== Ingredients ==

* Thick-cut [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* Firm-fleshed strong-flavoured [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]], [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]]
* Toppings (e.g. pickles, [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], etc.)

== Procedure ==

# Toast one side of the bread under a medium [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]].
# Lightly toast the other side of the bread, just enough to warm it, then spread the grated cheese over it. Add desired toppings.
# Broil the cheesy side of the bread until the cheese is bubbling and brown.
# Eat quickly, but be careful, as the cheese will be tongue-burningly hot!
